# Boords

> > Boords is a storyboarding and animatic creation platform for video production, animation, and film pre-production workflows.

Boords provides collaborative tools for storyboard creation, version control, AI-powered image generation, and team feedback management. The platform serves filmmakers, animators, instructional designers, and video production teams with templates, tutorials, and real-time collaboration features.

## Key Topics

- Storyboarding
- Animatics
- Pre-production
- Video production workflow
- Film editing and post-production
- Version control and iteration
- Client feedback and collaboration
- AI-powered image variations
- Animation production
- Instructional design
- Color theory in film
- Foreshadowing techniques
- Music video production
- Team collaboration tools
- Storyboard templates

## Core Platform Features

- [Versioning](https://boords.com/iterate/versioning): Version control feature for storyboard iterations with preserved comments
- [Image Variations](https://boords.com/iterate/image-variations): AI-powered feature to generate scene variations for storyboard iteration
- [Real-Time Updates](https://boords.com/collaborate/real-time-updates): Live syncing feature for team collaboration and storyboard updates
- [Instructional Design Storyboard Templates](https://boords.com/storyboard-template/instructional-design): Free instructional design storyboard templates for learning experiences
- [Boords Partner Program](https://boords.com/partner): Affiliate program offering 20% recurring commission via FirstPromoter

## Documentation & User Guides

- [Inviting & Managing Users](https://boords.com/docs/team-users): Guide for inviting teammates and managing user access control in Boords
- [Templates](https://boords.com/docs/templates): Documentation for storyboard templates, custom fields, and project setup
- [Activity & Notifications](https://boords.com/docs/activity-and-notifications): Track workspace changes and manage notifications with Activity Log
- [Team Settings](https://boords.com/docs/team-settings): Customize workspace with team branding, logo, and custom subdomain settings

## Storyboarding & Animatic Tutorials

- [How to Make an Animatic](https://boords.com/animatic/how-to-make-an-animatic): Comprehensive guide to animatic creation tools, techniques, and best practices
- [How to Storyboard a Music Video](https://boords.com/how-to-storyboard/music-video): Step-by-step guide for music video storyboarding and pre-production planning
- [How to Storyboard with Google Slides](https://boords.com/how-to-storyboard/google-slides): Tutorial for creating storyboards and animatics using Google Slides
- [How to Make an Animatic in Photoshop](https://boords.com/animatic/how-to-make-an-animatic-in-photoshop): Tutorial for creating animatics using Adobe Photoshop video timeline

## Filmmaking & Production Guides

- [A Guide to Foreshadowing in Film](https://boords.com/blog/foreshadowing): Film technique guide on using foreshadowing in storytelling and screenwriting
- [How to Use Color Theory in Film](https://boords.com/blog/color-theory-in-film): Guide to color palette selection and color psychology in cinematography
- [What is Post-Production in Film & Animation?](https://boords.com/blog/what-is-post-production-in-film-and-animation): Overview of post-production phases in filmmaking and animation workflow
- [Filmmaking 101: What is Film Editing?](https://boords.com/blog/filmmaking-101-what-is-film-editing): Beginner guide to film editing techniques and post-production process
- [How to Stay Organized During The Pre-Production Process](https://boords.com/blog/how-to-stay-organized-during-the-pre-production-process): Pre-production organization tips for video and animation projects
